description: Commercial and Residential Hourly Load Profiles for all TMY3 Locations in the United States is a data resource listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Thermal demand > USA", published or maintained by en.openei.org (publisher inferred from the link). The dataset Commercial and Residential Hourly Load Profiles for all TMY3 Locations in the United States on OpenEI contains hourly load profiles (for both electricity and heat) for synthetic reference buildings, modelled at over 1000 different locations (i.e. the TMY3 weather stations). Coverage: as stated on the linked page. The openmod wiki page "Thermal demand" lists it under "USA". It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the wiki page (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support thermal (heat) demand inputs to energy-system models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
